decisions.reason: The source-collection change does not alter the substantive-moment standard. Message 179 independently modifies that standard, and the candidate already has the corresponding same-message MODIFY.
Selecting Arden Vale's long-form YouTube videos does not itself change narrative completeness. The separate completeness clause in message 179 is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
The permitted source collection does not determine clip duration. Message 179 separately establishes the 70-85 second range, which is already represented under this candidate.
Changing the permitted source collection does not modify the requirement to follow the current brand guidelines for hooks.
The source-video selection decision does not change the clean, simple, professional visual-editing standard or its prohibited treatments.
The permitted source collection has no necessary effect on the white-text-only and no-text-effects requirements.
Identifying the videos from which clips will be sourced does not necessarily change the deferred task-local trial batch or its assigned count.
The source-selection change does not alter the 140-approved-clips quota, approval authority, or rejected-clip treatment. Other output details in message 179 are independent of the source Event.
The selection of Arden Vale's long-form YouTube videos does not change the dedicated Instagram account's type, assignment, or posting purpose.
The source-video decision does not alter which posted clips are tracked, the tracked metrics, or tracking transparency.
The permitted source collection does not change the requirement to use the exact caption font specified by the brand guidelines.
